_doc: Town types (one per faction) with branching building trees, plus economy tuning. Building effects: income{resources}, dwelling{creature}, growth{creature, amount}, growth_pct{pct} (all dwellings in the town), defense{amount} (garrison defense when besieged), tavern (hire heroes), market (trading; more markets = better rates), build_discount{resources: fraction} (cheaper construction in this town), battle_spoils{gold_per_xp} (owner earns gold for every victory), dwelling_upgrade{creature: base id} (recruit the base's upgrade from the same pool and convert stacks in town; must require the base dwelling), army_upgrade{name, attack?, defense?, initiative?, morale?, hp_pct?, damage_pct?, ranged_damage_pct?, shot_resist_pct?, abilities?} (the faction's ultimate building: every creature of the town's faction in the owner's armies and garrisons gets these bonuses in battle; abilities are granted like creature abilities, a stronger copy the creature already has wins; one per faction, does not stack; counts as tier 8 for a campaign chapter's max_tier). Every effect is implemented in src/economy and src/game/game_session.gd. Categories are display groups only.

market._doc: Trade value of one unit in gold. One market trades at base_rate; each extra market adds rate_per_extra_market up to max_rate. Buying and selling both lose (1 - rate), so a round trip is expensive.
